topic: The cricket ball that killed a batsman and changed the rules forever
hook: A cricket ball killed a man and rewrote the rulebook.
script: A cricket ball killed a man and rewrote the rulebook. In 2014, Phil Hughes was struck by a bouncer and collapsed on the pitch. He passed away two days later. Within months cricket mandated better helmets worldwide. His number, 408, was retired forever. No Australian cricketer will ever wear it again. Follow for cricket moments that changed the sport forever.
